user_story: As a user, I want deleting a non-existent task to return a clear error so that I know the operation failed.

positive.title: Successful deletion of an existing task
steps: Create a task with a valid ID.
Delete the task using the valid ID.
Check for the confirmation message of deletion.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully deleted and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Deletion attempt of a non-existent task
steps: Attempt to delete a task with an ID that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating that the task does not exist is returned.

edge.title: Deletion attempt with a null ID
steps: Attempt to delete a task with a null or empty ID.
edge.expected_result: An error message indicating that the task ID is invalid is returned.
